why: Re-measured: `voiceDisclosure` is defined once (master.html:9410) and rendered from exactly one place, `STATES.voice`'s .darkFoot (18684) — no other state emits it. Driven at 1440x960 on notes.voice, `.dark` is `position:absolute; inset:0; background:var(--ink)` and measures 1440x960, so it fully covers the only text field in Notes (.topField, 496x55 at y=108); the full screen text is Dictating / LISTENING / 0:01 / transcript / the disclosure / Cancel / Stop and read it back — nobody types on it. The second sentence is therefore true and irrelevant, and by naming typing specifically it carries the false implicature that the local-until-save guarantee is about the verb she is NOT performing, at the one moment she is asking whether her speech has already left.
sharpenedFix: Confirmed, but the seat's replacement over-claims. "What you say stays on this device until you save" asserts the SPEECH stays local, which collapses the distinction sentence one just drew ("keeps the words, not the audio") and would commit the product to on-device transcription — a bigger claim than the surface can honour. Change master.html:9410 (and src/fixture.js:625, which is the same string) to "Signal Studio keeps the words, not the audio. These words stay on this device until you save." Same two-sentence shape, same length class, same plain register as "Held on this device." elsewhere; "these words" points at the transcript visibly accumulating in .darkSaid, so it answers her question about the thing she can see without asserting anything about where the audio was turned into text.

why: Re-measured, not taken on trust: `[data-app="tasks"] .board.listBoard` sets `padding: 0 25px 28px` at _gate-suite.html:1633 and is never overridden anywhere (grep: one declaration, no media-query variant), while `.board` at :1824 sets `padding: 0 16px 84px` with the comment that spells out why (48 dock + 18 inset + 18 clearance). Driven with the list scrolled to its true end (scrollTop clamped at max), document.elementFromPoint at the centre of the last row's `.lrowTitle` and `.lrowWho` returns `INPUT.dockInput` at 768x1024, 1024x800 and 1199x900 — 'Send registrar paperwork two weeks before' and 'Mara & Finn' are behind the opaque white dock (bg rgb(255,255,255), opacity 1); only the `.when` chip '2 Jul' clears it. The board at 1280 and 1920 hit-tests `P.cardTitle` (clean), and 390 has no overlapping float at all, so the reserve was written twice and only once correctly, exactly as claimed.
sharpenedFix: The mechanism is right; one number in it is wrong. Change _gate-suite.html:1633 `padding: 0 25px 28px` to `padding: 0 25px 84px`, and add the phone exception — but make it `28px`, not the seat's `14px`. The phone list is currently correct at 28px (verified: no overlapping fixed/absolute chrome at 390x844) and the board's 14px is the board's own phone value for a different scroller; taking the list from 28 to 14 changes a surface that is not broken. So: `@media (max-width: 720px) { [data-app="tasks"] .board.listBoard { padding-bottom: 28px; } }` — the ≤720 block at :3554 that already hides the dock at :3622 is where it belongs. Verified by injection: at 768x1024 scrollHeight 1074→1130 and the last row's bottom 984→928 against a dock top of 946, the same 18px the board gives; 1024x800 743→799 and 1199x900 705→761, hit test back to `P.lrowTitle` at all three, and 390 unchanged.

why: Re-read the template and re-drove it: src/tasks.js:448 emits `(done ? "" : ' aria-roledescription="Movable task"')` while :449 emits aria-keyshortcuts unconditionally, and at 1920x1000 on tasks.board all 5 of the 13 cards in Done report aria-roledescription null with `Space ArrowUp ArrowDown ArrowLeft ArrowRight` still attached and draggable="true". They are genuinely movable: focusing demo-t-09, Space set aria-grabbed="true" and data-force="moving", ArrowLeft then Enter landed it in Waiting — and the roledescription reappeared the instant it left the lane. The list row is a separate and internally consistent model (no roledescription, shortcuts `Enter ArrowUp ArrowDown`, no carry), so this is only the board card, and nothing in interaction-check.mjs asserts roledescription at all.
sharpenedFix: The seat's edit is correct — delete the conditional so :448 reads `' aria-roledescription="Movable task"'` — but it names only one of the two places it has to land. master.html is generated and never hand-edited, so the change goes in src/tasks.js:448 and then `node build.mjs`; the driven copies are master.html:12087 and _gate-suite.html:12095 and both must end up carrying it, or the panel will re-drive the old bytes. Note also what the drive turned up alongside it: carrying a done card out of Done clears data-done (demo-t-09 came out of the move with done=false), so 'movable' and 'done' are already coupled in the model — which is the argument for naming the card movable in both states rather than for making Done cards immovable.

why: Re-measured from a fresh page with no interaction: `.trayBody` computes overflow-x auto (it only declares overflow-y, and the spec promotes the visible axis), and scrollWidth-clientWidth per lane is tasks.dense [0,0,0,0,0]@1440, [3,4,0,0,0]@1400, [27,28,18,0,0]@1280, [43,44,34,0,0]@1200 and tasks.board [13,14,4,0,0]@1280 — within 1px of the seat everywhere. scrollWidth is a constant 241px at every width because the culprit is fixed in space: `.cardDots`' content-box 44px target sits at x 324-359 whatever the lane does, and its `::before` at inset -4px adds the last 4px to 363 (removing the ::before drops the overflow 27→23, measured). It is user-reachable exactly as claimed — mouse.wheel(120,0) over To do at dense/1280 takes scrollLeft to 27/27, the first card slides 128→101, its tick goes 139→112 and is sliced by the lane's clip edge at 122, while the 'To do' heading stays at 144. The real band is 1200-1419 for the board (at 1199 the view is a list and there are no lanes at all), so the id's low end is one pixel generous.
sharpenedFix: The one-line change is right; the seat's reasoning for it is wrong twice and must not be pasted into the CSS as a comment. (1) `overflow-x: clip` beside `overflow-y: auto` COMPUTES TO `hidden` — verified, getComputedStyle returns overflowX 'hidden' with clip specified — so it does not 'create no scroll container in X': `scrollIntoView({inline:'nearest'})` on the dots still moved the lane 23px with clip applied. This is the mirror of the rule this very file already documents in the `.who` comment at _gate-suite.html:1372-1375. (2) `overflow-clip-margin: 4px` is therefore inert and would silently do nothing. So write `[data-app="tasks"] .trayBody { overflow-x: hidden; }` and say that is what it is. It is still the right fix: the wheel gesture dies (verified, scrollLeft stays 0 after wheel(120,0)), and nothing visible is lost because everything past the padding box is ALREADY clipped by today's `auto` — at dense/1280 the first card's ··· glyph already paints 2 of its 15px and its centre already hit-tests to SECTION.tray, identical before and after. Also drop the redundant `.cardDots::before` (the padding already provides the 44px target its own comment argues for) to take the phantom width down 4px at source. Do not chase the remaining ~23px by letting the foot shrink: `.cardFoot > .who { flex: 0 0 auto }` is a recorded decision ('whose wedding it is never shrinks'), and the product's own carry code deliberately never calls a horizontal scrollIntoView (it hand-computes scrollTop; the four scrollIntoView calls are block-only and a driven Space+Arrow carry leaves all five lanes at scrollLeft 0), so hiding closes every route a person can actually take.
